name: Recurrent Gaussian Update
aliases: Recurrent Gaussian Update — Feedback Loop Update, ReSplat (Recurrent Gaussian Splatting), Recurrent Gaussian Splating, Recurrent Refinement
definition: A recurrent network that iteratively refines initial Gaussian predictions by predicting incremental updates to Gaussian parameters and hidden states based on rendering errors from input views.
summary: Recurrent Gaussian Update is a gradient-free method that iteratively refines 3D Gaussian parameters using a learned recurrent network to map rendering errors to updates, avoiding slow gradient descent.
